studio-small-09-256.hdr

"Studio Small 09" by Sergej Majboroda — Poly Haven
https://polyhaven.com/a/studio_small_09
License: CC0 1.0 (public domain dedication)

Downsampled from the 1k release to 256x128 and re-encoded as flat RGBE.
It is only ever used as a blurred environment map, so the extra resolution
cost nothing visually and ~1.4 MB of page weight.
